Shikho · Product exploration · 17 Oct 2026

Year End Wrap 2026: can we ship it?

What I checked: the prototype repo ShikhoTech/shikho-year-end-wrap, the live link, and the Shikho tech spec for the Android app, analytics, data warehouse, Airflow pipelines, academic program, KPI, leaderboard and notification services. Below: what the prototype is, where every number would come from, what has to be built, the risks, and what we can add.

Prototype: shikho-year-end-wrap.vercel.appSpec source: shikho-spec MCP (40+ projects)
VerdictDoablefor a late-December launch

Most of the data already exists. The warehouse keeps per-student daily activity, minutes by activity type, live-class attendance, quizzes and video watch time. One yearly batch job can compute every number the prototype shows.

We are upgrading an existing feature, not starting from zero. The Android app already has a "Year Review": an 8-page animated story with a share button (:feature:quarterreview, YearReviewUseCase), backed by a student_yearly_reports collection in academic-program. The wrap can replace its content and reuse its entry point, data contract and analytics events.

The real work is in three places: agreeing what each metric means, a data quality pass on real students, and turning the prototype into a production screen (it is a design prototype with sample data, and sharing is simulated).

Moving through: tap right for next, left for back. Each screen plays its animation and then moves on, except the learner type, which waits for a tap.
Close any time: X closes the story. Progress is kept, and the home banner (or Profile in C3) reopens it where the student stopped.
From the end: শেয়ার করো goes to the share sheet (9). আবার দেখো starts again from the cover (1).
Light users: a screen is skipped when there is nothing worth showing, e.g. under 10 quizzes. These rules are not written yet.

1 · What the boss built

The prototype

Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, no build step, deployed on Vercel. A picker loads three design directions in a phone frame. Each one opens from a home-screen banner (তোমার ২০২৬ তৈরি) that grows into the story. The example student is নিশাত, Class 9 Science, and every number is made up. The motion work is careful: one clock per slide, reduced-motion mode, a low-memory mode for phones with 2 GB RAM or less, and fps measured on throttled CPUs.

All three versions share the same story: study days, longest streak, hours, live classes, quizzes, video minutes, a "learner type" reveal, share cards and an end screen. The live, quiz and video slides each give the student an earned title.

Needs most work

A3 · Poster

Big gold Bangla numbers on the purple stage, a scratch card for the learner type, 187 dots forming ২০২৭ at the end.

  • 16 segments, but only 8 slides are built (1, 4–7, 11, 15, 16)
  • Some numbers are typed into the markup
Medium

B3 · Marksheet

The year as a school notebook (khata): rubber stamp, attendance register, a marksheet-style share card.

  • Strong cultural fit for Bangladeshi students
  • Heaviest on low-end phones: 18–23 fps on some moments at 4× CPU throttle
Closest to production

C3 · Journey

The bird walks the year: 365-day grid, school at night, a door that opens on the learner type, road to the 2027 flag.

  • All data in one object (D) and slides in one array, so swapping in real data is easy
  • About 60 fps on every moment after tuning
  • 9 slides, so it is the shortest story

Screenshots taken today from the live link at phone size (390×844), each frozen at the end of its animation. Click any screenshot in section 2 to open that screen live.

Gaps I found in the code, all normal for a prototype:

  • The study-day calendar is made up from a seeded random number generator. Production needs a real array of 365 values per student.
  • The share sheet is a drawing with a toast. Nothing is saved or shared yet.
  • Fonts load from Google Fonts. Inside the app they should be bundled so the story works on slow connections.
  • The mascot images are small upscaled crops from screenshots. The Figma exports are still needed.
  • Titles, the learner type name and much of the copy are marked "not signed off" in the prototype's own notes.
  • No rule yet for students with very little activity, for example under 10 quizzes, which shows no title at all.

Live classes

তুমি ৭২টার মধ্যে ৬৩টা লাইভ ক্লাসে ছিলেState ?s=live · all threeData needs check

Attended out of total, plus an earned title: তোমার খেতাব · ফার্স্ট বেঞ্চার.
Rules
80%+ ফার্স্ট বেঞ্চার · 50–79% লাইভ ক্লাসের নিয়মিত · below 50% লাইভ ক্লাসে হাজির. Below 50% the "out of 72" is hidden and the text reads only তুমি Nটা লাইভ ক্লাসে ছিলে.
Motion
AA ring of 72 seats. A pulse runs round once and lights each attended seat gold. Missed seats stay empty.BA register book (হাজিরা খাতা) with 6×12 boxes, ticks and magenta dots for missed classes. The total cell zooms out into a panel: ৬৩/৭২ · হাজিরা ৮৮%.CA classroom narrowing toward the board. A glass lens moves from the back row to the front and lights attended seats.
Data
liveAttended, liveTotal. Optional: which classes were missed, so the empty seats are real and not invented.
Production
Agree whether watching the recording counts as attending. Students in several programs have more than 72 classes, so the ring and register must handle any total (cap the drawing at 100 seats and scale).

The copy says ছবিটা তোমার ফোনেই তৈরি হয়। কোথাও আপলোড হয় না। (the image is made on your phone and never uploaded).
Production
Nothing is generated or shared today. Production needs a real image and the Android share intent through the JS bridge. This promise conflicts with rendering images on the server, so either draw them on the phone (canvas) or change the copy. My suggestion: draw on the phone for app sharing, and render on the server only for the public link preview.

This is built from every field the three directions read. The batch job writes one of these per student, and the screen reads it in one call. Titles and learner type are computed on the server, so the app never needs the rules.

6 · Where to work

How it fits together

ExistsWarehouse + bronzeDaily activity, durations, attendance, quizzes, watch logs. S3 parquet archive.
NewWrap batch jobOne Airflow DAG in data_pipeline_bronze. Computes a snapshot per student, run on 15 Dec and again on 31 Dec.
Exists, extendstudent_yearly_reportsacademic-program collection, already read by GetStudentYearlyReportData. Add a wrap_2026 JSON field.
Exists, extendGatewayGraphQL query the app already calls for the Year Review. Return the new fields.
NewWrap screenIn the Android app and the web portal. Entry from a Focus Hub card and a push notification.

Data: metric definitions + batch job

Data team · 3–4 wks
  • Write a one-page metric dictionary and get it signed off before writing SQL. This is the most important step.
  • Year window: 1 Jan–31 Dec 2026, Bangladesh time (Asia/Dhaka), as the Focus Hub already does.
  • Build the DAG: one row per student containing every number, the 365-day array, top subject and chapter, titles and learner type.
  • Check the numbers by hand for 50 real students, including heavy users, light users, multi-program students and trial converts.
  • Look at the distributions, then set the title thresholds from real data.

Backend: store + serve

Backend · 1–2 wks
  • Write the snapshot into student_yearly_reports, or a new collection in the same service. It is precomputed, so serving it is a single document read.
  • Extend GetStudentYearlyReportData and the gateway query. Add a flag that says whether the wrap is ready for this student.
  • Add a public endpoint for share links, reusing the analytics public_reports table and the mask URL shortener.
  • Load-test for the release day spike, when every student opens it at once.

Client: the story screen

Frontend + Mobile · 4–5 wks
  • Rebuild the chosen direction as a production web page that reads real data, keeping the motion code.
  • Run it inside the Android app in a WebView, using the same JS bridge pattern as Shikho AI and model test: token in, native share and haptics out.
  • The same page then works on app.shikho.com for web users with no extra build.
  • Bundle fonts and mascots, preload the next slide, and cache for repeat opens.

Share, entry and tracking

Backend + Mobile · 1–2 wks
  • Share images: draw the cards on the phone (canvas) for in-app sharing, which keeps the prototype's promise that nothing is uploaded. Use certificate-image-generator, which already renders images to S3 and CloudFront, only for the preview picture of a public share link.
  • Entry point: a Focus Hub card with a deep link (cards already have a priority and a CTA), plus the existing Year Review button.
  • Push: the notification service already sends yearly certificate pushes on a schedule. Add one for "your 2026 is ready".
  • Events in CleverTap: opened, slide reached, completed, shared and the share target. Reuse the year_report_share event name.

Native screen or WebView?

Recommended

Web page inside the app

  • Reuses most of the prototype's motion code, which is the expensive part
  • One build for Android and web
  • Copy and fixes ship without a Play Store release, which matters in a holiday launch week
  • The JS bridge already exists in two products
  • Risk: WebView speed on old phones. The prototype's low-memory mode and fps tests are a good start, but test on real 2 GB phones
Slower

Native Compose in :feature:quarterreview

  • Fastest feel, and it fits the existing Year Review code
  • Every animation has to be rewritten in Compose (particles, springs, glass lens, elastic type), so about 2× the client effort
  • Android only. Web users get nothing
  • Every fix needs an app release and a staged rollout
7 · What could go wrong

Risks and gaps

High

Wrong numbers break trust. Several pipelines have no tests, no retries and no alerts. The specs also flag known issues: the KPI attendee schema mismatch, the analytics TEST.* consumer doing nothing, some report endpoints returning dummy data, and aggregated_user_activity only existing since Aug 2026. Build from the long-running warehouse tables and check numbers by hand before launch.

High

Hour-of-day data may be gone. Raw watch logs are deleted after 9–90 days. Confirm this week that the S3 bronze archive covers the whole year. If it doesn't, plan the night slide around the data we have.

Medium

Students with little activity. A student with 4 study days should never see a slide that makes them feel bad. Rules needed: skip slides under a floor, never show "x of 72" below 50% (the prototype already does this for live classes), and give every student a positive learner type. Decide whether students below a minimum get the wrap at all.

Medium

Privacy for minors. Students are 12–19. Share cards should show first name only, never school, phone or rank, and keep the prototype's "hide my name" option. Public share links must not show more than the card does.

Medium

Release day load. Pushing to every student at once means a traffic spike. Precompute everything, serve from cache, and send pushes in batches by class.

Medium

Sign-offs still open. Titles, learner type names, new copy and mascot art are all marked unapproved in the prototype notes. Final copy should be ready by week 6.

Low

Bangla rendering. The prototype already fixed the Hind Siliguri digit ১ issue and splits graphemes safely. Keep those fixes when moving to production.

8 · The main question

What more we can add

Sorted by how much I think each one adds. Each idea names the data it would use. The ones with a pink border are my top picks.

New slides from data we already have

তুমি ৮২% শিক্ষার্থীর চেয়ে বেশি দিন পড়েছ

A percentile against classmates in the same class. It turns a raw number into a sense of standing without ranking anyone publicly. Show it only when the student is in the top half.

Computed in the batch job
সবচেয়ে বেশি উন্নতি: রসায়ন, Q1 থেকে Q4

Most improved subject. Students care about progress more than totals, and this works for weaker students too.

student_quarterly_reports, report card v2 scores
যে টপিক কঠিন ছিল, এখন পারো

Topics that were marked "needs improvement" and later moved up. This shows learning happened, not just activity.

Topic dexterity (live-exam, data-aggregators)
শিখো AI কে ৩৪টা প্রশ্ন করেছ

Doubts asked, the subject asked about most, and the funniest or hardest question if moderation allows.

gen-ai conversation store
তোমার প্রথম দিন: ১২ মার্চ, গতি

A first-day memory: the first class or video of the year. Wraps feel personal when they recall something specific.

Earliest activity row
যে স্যারের ক্লাসে সবচেয়ে বেশি ছিলে

Favourite teacher, by live classes attended. Pair it with a short thank-you clip recorded by that teacher (about 10 teachers cover most students).

Live class lessons + teacher
এ বছর ৯টা ব্যাজ পেয়েছ

Badges earned in 2026 and the rarest one.

gamification service
শুক্রবার তোমার সেরা দিন

Best weekday and peak month. This only needs daily data, so it is a safe replacement if the after-9 pm slide is dropped.

Daily table
স্কুলে তুমি #৩

Rank among Shikho students from the same school. Show only to the top 10, never to the rest.

leaderboard GetSchoolLeaderBoard

Growth and business

Share link with a referral code

Every shared card links to a public page (shikho.com/wrap/…) with a preview image and an "admit with my friend's code" button. A share becomes an admission lead. Promo-referral, short links and public report pages already exist.

A version for parents

Parents pay, so a separate summary for guardians sent by SMS (link) is the biggest retention lever. It should focus on attendance, hours and improvement. Guardian contacts exist in the user sync, and the CRM already sends report card SMS.

Story-size images

9:16 images sized for Facebook and Instagram stories and WhatsApp status, which is where Bangladeshi students actually share. Rendered on the server so every phone gets the same sharp image.

"Shikho 2026 in numbers"

One public page with totals for the whole platform: hours studied, classes held, quizzes taken. Good for marketing, PR and free users who have no personal wrap.

Free and trial users

A short 3-slide wrap for free users, ending on what paid students got this year. Do this only after paid students are served.

Try two directions

Ship two directions to different groups of students and measure completion and share rate, then roll out the winner.

Experience polish

Sound and haptics

An optional music loop (off by default, tap to start) and a short vibration on the stamp, badge and door moments, sent through the JS bridge.

Countdown before release

A home banner a week early ("তোমার ২০২৬ আসছে ২৬ ডিসেম্বর") so students are waiting for it, as with Spotify Wrapped.

Low-data mode

Lots of students are on mobile data. Keep the first load under 1 MB, fetch mascots as WebP, and skip particles on slow connections.

Mascot easter egg

Tapping the bird on the end screen plays a different pose each time. It costs very little and gives students something to talk about.

Screen reader text

Each slide gets one plain Bangla sentence for screen readers, such as "তুমি ১৮৭ দিন পড়েছ". The motion is decoration, so reduced-motion mode already covers most of the rest.

Keep it after December

Leave the wrap in the profile all year as "আমার ২০২৬", so it can be reopened and next year's wrap can compare against it.

10 · Needed from the boss and product

Decisions to make this week

  1. Which direction. My pick is C3 Journey. It is the most data-ready and the smoothest on cheap phones. B3's marksheet share card could be borrowed as one of C3's three cards.
  2. Who gets it. Paid students only, or trial users too? What is the minimum activity to get a wrap?
  3. What counts. Definitions of a study day, live class attendance (live only, or live plus recording) and a quiz.
  4. Web page in the app, or native screen. My recommendation is a web page in the app.
  5. Sharing rules. What can appear on a public card and link, and whether to attach a referral code.
  6. Which new slides. Pick 2–3 from section 8. My shortlist: percentile, most improved subject, topics that got stronger.
Based on the ShikhoTech/shikho-year-end-wrap repo (commit d6b2e9d) and the shikho-spec documents dated Jun–Aug 2026. The spec documents are generated from code and can be out of date, so table names should be checked against production before building. Prepared for nusrat.mim@shikho.com.
